name: Can engineered hardwood be installed in kitchens or basements?
description: Yes, engineered hardwood can be installed in kitchens and basements, but proper moisture mitigation and consistent humidity control are vital for durability.

mainEntity.name: Can engineered hardwood be installed in kitchens or basements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineered hardwood can be installed in kitchens and basements, but careful consideration of moisture levels is crucial. Its layered construction makes it more resistant to humidity fluctuations than solid hardwood, but it is not waterproof. For basement installations, a vapor barrier is highly recommended, and consistent indoor humidity control is essential. Hometelligent Inc. always assesses the moisture conditions of specific areas like basements in Fremont or Pleasanton before recommending engineered hardwood to ensure long-term durability.
